_note: Individual-stock top gainers/laggards aren't available from a free, keyless source, so this file is maintained by hand — same pattern as ipos.json and calendar.json. Update it daily from your broker/exchange screener, or wire up a screener API (Finnhub and Alpha Vantage both have free tiers) in src/routes/api.js. Each side is capped at 5 entries; 'pct' is percent change on the day, or null when only a name/theme is known.
